lang.name: English
profile.title: Seller profile
profile.hint: This is what the skill learns in the interview. You can also adjust it here.
profile.tone: Tone of voice (e.g. direct and friendly)
profile.cta: Call to action (e.g. Can I show you in 10 minutes?)
search.title: Find companies on Google Maps
search.nokey: Set your Google Places API key in the Settings tab.
leads.title: Companies found
leads.empty: No companies yet. Run a search.
col.name: Company
drafts.title: Messages to approve
drafts.note: Approving marks the message as ready. An email only goes out when you click Send with Gmail. WhatsApp is still manual.
draft.subject: Subject
settings.send.title: Sending settings
settings.send.note: These apply to Gmail sending: daily limit, interval, days and hours. The app never sends on its own: every message needs your approval and your click.
settings.mode.manual: Manual (I approve and click send on every message)
settings.typing: Simulate typing ("typing...") before sending. Only applies to WhatsApp, coming soon.
api.title: Google Places API key
api.label: API key
api.help: Create the key in Google Cloud (Places API (New)). It is stored only on this computer, unencrypted.
overview.title: Prospecting overview
overview.note: Emails sent and replied to through Gmail are recorded automatically. For WhatsApp you mark them in Messages.
email.notfound: No email found on the website.
reply.label: Reply received (optional)
role.title: What role will your employee work in today?
role.hint: When you pick one, the skill acts with senior-level knowledge of that area. You can switch anytime.
cnpj.title: Companies from Brazil's Federal Revenue (CNPJ)
cnpj.hint: Reads the Establishments files you downloaded from the CNPJ open-data portal and placed in data/cnpj. Brings the registered email and phone.
gmail.title: Gmail (send and read replies)
gmail.help: Create an OAuth client of type Desktop app in Google Cloud (Gmail API enabled) with redirect http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/gmail/callback, and paste the ID and secret here. They stay on this computer only, unencrypted.
gmail.opened: Authorize in the tab that opened, then come back.
no.email: No email: use Find email in Companies.
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp via QR Code (coming soon)
whatsapp.note: Planned option: connect a number by scanning a QR Code, at no cost. Warning: it is an unofficial connection and WhatsApp may ban the number. When it exists, use a secondary number, few messages per day and only for people who can expect your message. For larger volume, the safe path is the official (paid) API.
